objective: Discover and summarize the oldest/legacy and largest already-materialized economic backtest evidence available in the repository for presentation of what was developed.
allowed_scope: read already-materialized legacy backtest, trade, return, cost and benchmark columns
rank candidate backtest artifacts by legacy/backtest evidence and coverage
materialize a presentation-only candidate table and JSON summary
compute descriptive retrospective statistics for presentation/demo use
forbidden_claims: portfolio Sharpe/equity curve/max drawdown claim unless supported by an explicit financed portfolio artifact
firewall_note: This demo track may read legacy realized return columns already materialized in the repository, but every output must be labelled retrospective, presentation-only and non-confirmatory.
presentation_positioning: Use this to show the engineering pipeline and the maximum available legacy backtest coverage, not to change the scientific conclusion of the challenge.
